# Download Raw Data Sources

Run this notebook to fetch all raw dataset files directly into the `shared_data_test_sandbox` folder for testing.

```{python}
import concurrent.futures
import gzip
import io
import re
import shutil
import sys
import time
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import pandas as pd
import requests
from tqdm import tqdm

# Discover project root and isolate outputs strictly to the test sandbox directory
def find_repo_root():
    p = Path(__file__).resolve().parent if "__file__" in locals() else Path.cwd()
    while p != p.parent:
        if (p / "requirements.txt").exists() or (p / ".git").exists():
            return p
        p = p.parent
    return Path.cwd()

ROOT_DIR = find_repo_root()
BASE_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "shared_data_test_sandbox"

# Standard User-Agent to prevent 403 / 502 gateway errors from federal servers
HTTP_HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0",
}

def extract_qcew_518(zip_path: Path, output_csv_path: Path):
    """Stream-extracts only NAICS code 518 rows from a quarterly BLS singlefile zip."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as z:
        member = next((m for m in z.namelist() if m.endswith(".csv")), None)
        if member:
            with z.open(member) as f:
                chunks = []
                for chunk in pd.read_csv(f, chunksize=100000, low_memory=False, dtype={"industry_code": str, "area_fips": str}):
                    filtered = chunk[chunk["industry_code"] == "518"]
                    if not filtered.empty:
                        chunks.append(filtered)
                if chunks:
                    df = pd.concat(chunks, ignore_index=True)
                    df.to_csv(output_csv_path, index=False)
                    print(f"  -> Extracted NAICS 518 data to '{output_csv_path.name}' ({len(df):,} rows)")
                    return True
        raise FileNotFoundError("Could not find CSV singlefile in quarterly BLS zip archive.")

# --- Dynamic Resolvers for Fragile Links ---


def resolve_usda_unemployment():
    print("Resolving current USDA Unemployment link...")
    url = "https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/county-level-data-sets/county-level-data-sets-download-data/"
    r = requests.get(url, headers=HTTP_HEADERS, timeout=15)
    r.raise_for_status()
    # Match CSV download link with optional query parameters (?v=...)
    match = re.search(r'href="([^" ]*unemployment[^" ]*\.csv(?:\?[^" ]*)?)"', r.text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if match:
        link = urljoin(url, match.group(1))
        print(f"  -> Resolved USDA URL: {link}")
        return link
    raise ValueError("Could not find USDA Unemployment CSV link on the download page.")

def resolve_seer_population():
    print("Resolving current SEER Population link...")
    canonical_url = "https://seer.cancer.gov/popdata/yr1990_2024.20ages/us.1990_2024.20ages.adjusted.txt.gz"
    url = "https://seer.cancer.gov/popdata/download.html"
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, headers=HTTP_HEADERS, timeout=10)
        r.raise_for_status()
        match = re.search(r'href="([^" ]+us\.1990[^" ]+\.20ages\.adjusted\.txt\.gz)"', r.text, re.IGNORECASE)
        if match:
            link = urljoin(url, match.group(1))
            print(f"  -> Scraped SEER URL: {link}")
            return link
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  -> Note: SEER landing page returned ({e}), falling back to canonical URL.")
    
    print(f"  -> Using canonical SEER URL: {canonical_url}")
    return canonical_url


# --- Download Configuration ---

DOWNLOAD_CONFIG = [
    # County Codes, Geography, & Spatial Lookups
    {
        "url": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/geojson-counties-fips.json",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "county_fips_codes",
        "filename": "geojson_counties_fips.json",
    },
    {
        "url": "https://opendata.arcgis.com/api/v3/datasets/7495f87cfe1040468238b5b73042da9f_1/downloads/data?format=csv&spatialRefId=4326&where=1%3D1",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "county_fips_codes",
        "filename": "US_Counties_Centroids.csv",
    },
    {
        "url": "https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/codes2020/national_county2020.txt",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "county_fips_codes",
        "filename": "county_2020_fips_codes.csv",
    },
    {
        "url": "https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2021_Gazetteer/2021_Gaz_counties_national.zip",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "county_fips_codes",
        "filename": "2021_Gaz_counties_national.txt",
        "extract_pattern": "2021_Gaz_counties_national",
    },
    {
        "url": "https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2025_Gazetteer/2025_Gaz_counties_national.zip",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "county_fips_codes",
        "filename": "census_gazetteer_2025_county_sizes.txt",
        "extract_pattern": "2025_Gaz_counties_national",
    },
    # CDC Air Quality (PM2.5)
    {
        "url": "https://data.cdc.gov/api/views/53mz-4zqd/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "air",
        "filename": "Daily_County-Level_PM2.5_Concentrations_2001-2022_20260611.csv",
        "parallel_connections": 8,
    },
    # BEA Economic Indicators
    {
        "url": "https://apps.bea.gov/regional/zip/CAINC1.zip",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "personal_income",
        "filename": "personal_income_data.csv",
        "extract_pattern": "ALL_AREAS",
    },
    {
        "url": "https://apps.bea.gov/regional/zip/CAGDP1.zip",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "gdp",
        "filename": "gdp_data.csv",
        "extract_pattern": "ALL_AREAS",
    },
    # HUD Residential Construction Permits
    {
        "url": "https://opendata.arcgis.com/api/v3/datasets/da836467b4904711b14d74acbc4568be_24/downloads/data?format=csv&spatialRefId=4326&where=1%3D1",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "construction_permits",
        "filename": "Residential_Construction_Permits_by_County_6297027898887955680.csv",
    },
    # USDA Unemployment
    {
        "url": "DYNAMIC_USDA",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "unemployment_and_income",
        "filename": "Unemployment2023.csv",
    },
    # SEER Population (uncompressed to .txt)
    {
        "url": "DYNAMIC_SEER",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "population",
        "filename": "us.1990_2024.20ages.adjusted.txt",
        "decompress_gzip": True,
    }
]

# Census Business Patterns (CBP) 2001–2022
for year in range(2001, 2023):
    yy = str(year)[2:]
    DOWNLOAD_CONFIG.append({
        "url": f"https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/cbp/datasets/{year}/cbp{yy}co.zip",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "business_patterns",
        "filename": f"cbp{yy}co.txt",
        "extract_pattern": f"cbp{yy}co",
    })

# BLS QCEW (2004–2025): Download quarterly singlefile zip and extract NAICS 518 data only
for year in range(2004, 2026):
    DOWNLOAD_CONFIG.append({
        "url": f"https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/files/{year}/csv/{year}_qtrly_singlefile.zip",
        "folder": BASE_DIR / "qrtly_census_emp_and_wages",
        "filename": f"{year}_q1_q4_naics_518_data_only.csv",
        "qcew_extract_518": True,
        "delay_after": 0.5,
    })


# --- Download Execution Logic ---

def _download_chunk(url: str, start: int, end: int, target_path: Path, pbar: tqdm, timeout: tuple):
    headers = {**HTTP_HEADERS, "Range": f"bytes={start}-{end}"}
    with requests.get(url, headers=headers, stream=True, timeout=timeout) as r:
        r.raise_for_status()
        with open(target_path, "r+b") as f:
            f.seek(start)
            for chunk in r.iter_content(chunk_size=1048576):
                if chunk:
                    f.write(chunk)
                    pbar.update(len(chunk))

def download_file(item: dict, timeout: tuple = (10, 120)):
    target_path = item["folder"] / item["filename"]
    target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    if target_path.exists():
        print(f"Skipping {target_path.name} (already exists)")
        return True

    # Process dynamic URLs just-in-time
    url = item["url"]
    if url == "DYNAMIC_USDA":
        url = resolve_usda_unemployment()
    elif url == "DYNAMIC_SEER":
        url = resolve_seer_population()

    print(f"Downloading {target_path.name} from {url}...")

    # Pattern extraction from Zip (case-insensitive member matching)
    if "extract_pattern" in item:
        temp_zip_path = target_path.with_suffix(".temp.zip")
        try:
            with requests.get(url, headers=HTTP_HEADERS, stream=True, timeout=timeout) as response:
                response.raise_for_status()
                with open(temp_zip_path, "wb") as f_zip:
                    for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=1048576):
                        if chunk:
                            f_zip.write(chunk)
            with zipfile.ZipFile(temp_zip_path) as z:
                pattern = item["extract_pattern"].lower()
                member = next((f for f in z.namelist() if pattern in f.lower() and not f.endswith("/")), None)
                if member:
                    with z.open(member) as src, open(target_path, "wb") as dst:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
                    print(f"  -> Extracted '{member}' to '{target_path.name}' ({target_path.stat().st_size:,} bytes)")
                    return True
                else:
                    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Could not find entry matching '{item['extract_pattern']}' in zip")
        finally:
            if temp_zip_path.exists():
                temp_zip_path.unlink()

    # Gzip decompression (for SEER population)
    if item.get("decompress_gzip"):
        temp_gz_path = target_path.with_suffix(".temp.gz")
        try:
            for attempt in range(3):
                try:
                    with requests.get(url, headers=HTTP_HEADERS, stream=True, timeout=timeout) as response:
                        response.raise_for_status()
                        total_size = int(response.headers.get("content-length", 0))
                        with open(temp_gz_path, "wb") as f_gz, tqdm(total=total_size, unit="B", unit_scale=True, desc=temp_gz_path.name) as bar:
                            for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=1048576):
                                if chunk:
                                    f_gz.write(chunk)
                                    bar.update(len(chunk))
                    break
                except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
                    if attempt == 2:
                        raise e
                    print(f"  -> Download attempt {attempt + 1} failed ({e}), retrying in 3s...")
                    time.sleep(3)

            print(f"  -> Decompressing {temp_gz_path.name} to {target_path.name}...")
            with gzip.open(temp_gz_path, "rb") as src, open(target_path, "wb") as dst:
                shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
            print(f"  -> Decompressed to '{target_path.name}' ({target_path.stat().st_size:,} bytes)")
            return True
        finally:
            if temp_gz_path.exists():
                temp_gz_path.unlink()

    # QCEW NAICS 518 in-stream extraction from Zip
    if item.get("qcew_extract_518"):
        temp_zip_path = target_path.with_suffix(".temp.zip")
        try:
            with requests.get(url, headers=HTTP_HEADERS, stream=True, timeout=timeout) as response:
                response.raise_for_status()
                total_size = int(response.headers.get("content-length", 0))
                with open(temp_zip_path, "wb") as f_zip, tqdm(total=total_size, unit="B", unit_scale=True, desc=f"{item['filename']} (zip)") as bar:
                    for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=1048576):
                        if chunk:
                            f_zip.write(chunk)
                            bar.update(len(chunk))
            extract_qcew_518(temp_zip_path, target_path)
            return True
        finally:
            if temp_zip_path.exists():
                temp_zip_path.unlink()


    # Multi-connection parallel download if configured
    connections = item.get("parallel_connections", 1)
    if connections > 1:
        try:
            head_resp = requests.head(url, headers=HTTP_HEADERS, allow_redirects=True, timeout=(10, 30))
            head_resp.raise_for_status()
            total_size = int(head_resp.headers.get("content-length", 0))
            
            probe_headers = {**HTTP_HEADERS, "Range": "bytes=0-10"}
            with requests.get(url, headers=probe_headers, stream=True, timeout=(10, 30)) as probe_resp:
                supports_ranges = (probe_resp.status_code == 206)

            if supports_ranges and total_size > 0:
                print(f"  -> Using {connections} parallel connections...")
                with open(target_path, "wb") as f:
                    f.truncate(total_size)
                chunk_size = total_size // connections
                ranges = [(i * chunk_size, (i * chunk_size + chunk_size - 1) if i < connections - 1 else total_size - 1) for i in range(connections)]
                with tqdm(total=total_size, unit="B", unit_scale=True, desc=target_path.name) as pbar:
                    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=connections) as executor:
                        futures = [executor.submit(_download_chunk, url, start, end, target_path, pbar, timeout) for start, end in ranges]
                        concurrent.futures.wait(futures)
                return True
        except Exception:
            print("  -> Parallel check failed. Falling back to single stream.")

    # Standard stream download
    with requests.get(url, headers=HTTP_HEADERS, stream=True, timeout=timeout) as response:
        response.raise_for_status()
        total_size = int(response.headers.get("content-length", 0))
        with open(target_path, "wb") as f, tqdm(total=total_size, unit="B", unit_scale=True, desc=target_path.name) as bar:
            for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=1048576):
                if chunk:
                    f.write(chunk)
                    bar.update(len(chunk))

    if "delay_after" in item:
        time.sleep(item["delay_after"])
    return True

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(f"Total files scheduled: {len(DOWNLOAD_CONFIG)}")
    results = {}
    for item in DOWNLOAD_CONFIG:
        try:
            download_file(item)
            results[item["filename"]] = "SUCCESS"
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Failed to acquire {item['filename']}: {e}")
            results[item["filename"]] = f"FAILED: {e}"

    failed = [k for k, v in results.items() if v != "SUCCESS"]
    print(f"\nCompleted! Success: {len(results) - len(failed)} / {len(results)}. Failures: {len(failed)}")
```
